description: Without signing in: not available; the call asks the user to sign in. Signed in with a free QuantGeeks account: the full Active Levels rows (read rows included) for SPX, SPY, QQQ, META and AAPL only, as of the latest regime read of the trading day that is at least 60 minutes old; any other symbol: the result says it needs a QuantGeeks plan. With a QuantGeeks plan: live rows, refreshed every minute, for every name the desk supports; read rows included. What the desk's Active Levels widget shows: the strikes that matter right now for one book. For the index books that is the primary node, the two major nodes, the first hour's high and low and spot, each with its distance from price and how often today's tape has touched it; for a stock the same from its own gamma book, plus its ladder anchor. The SPX list also carries the current regime read's gates (the level that must hold), invalidation levels and roles (shelf, magnet, wall, trapdoor, hub). Net gamma is QuantGeeks GEX from the live frame (quote the strings as written). Regime reads cover the index books only; names say so in `note`.

symbol.description: Ticker, e.g. SPX (maps to its 0DTE option root SPXW), SPY, QQQ, VIX.
